summary: Eureka Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 1 to its Business Combination Agreement with Marine Thinking Inc. and its subsidiary. The amendment revises post-closing director requirements under section 5.19 of the original October 29, 2025 BCA; no other terms (price, premium, deal value) are disclosed or changed. The registrant is the SPAC issuer entering into the de-SPAC transaction. The filing is a material definitive agreement amendment specific to the SPAC merger process. Watch for any future extensions, shareholder vote, or regulatory approvals that could affect closing timing.
